description: Consumer-repository data for ops/ci_parity/fixtures.py. Each repository names its fixture roots and, per file, the exact rule ids each lane ('semgrep-l9', 'bandit', ...) must report there. A named rule that fires is expected and does not block; a named rule that does not fire is a FAIL; any other finding on a fixture path, and every finding outside the roots, is classified as before. A file under a root with no entry expects nothing, so any finding on it blocks.

Quantum-L9/Enrichment.Inference.Engine.note: CI canary for campaign L9-CI-UNIFIED-LEVERAGE-2026-11-20-v1.7.1 (branch canary/ci-ul-eie).
